findings.draft_passage: Suddenly one of these gypsies, in trembling opal, seizes a cocktail out of the air, dumps it down for courage and dances out alone on the canvas platform.
findings.source_has: The lights grow brighter as the earth lurches away from the sun, and now the orchestra is playing yellow cocktail music... The groups change more swiftly, swell with new arrivals, dissolve and form in the same breath; already there are wanderers, confident girls who weave here and there... Suddenly one of these gypsies, in trembling opal, seizes a cocktail out of the air...
findings.gate_test_answer: A reader would be genuinely confused about who “these gypsies” refers to, because the draft cut the antecedent sentence that defined the confident, wandering girls the phrase points back to.

findings.draft_passage: A succulent hash arrived, and Mr. Wolfshiem, forgetting the more sentimental atmosphere of the old Metropole, began to eat with ferocious delicacy.
findings.source_has: “This is a nice restaurant here,” said Mr. Wolfshiem… “But I like across the street better!” … “What place is that?” I asked. “The old Metropole.” “The old Metropole,” brooded Mr. Wolfshiem… A succulent hash arrived, and Mr. Wolfshiem, forgetting the more sentimental atmosphere of the old Metropole, began to eat…
findings.gate_test_answer: A reader is likely to stumble because “the old Metropole” is named without ever being identified in the draft; they can infer it’s the place across the street, but the specific name appears without introduction, creating a small placement gap rather than mere lost ornament.

findings.draft_passage: Wolfshiem's answer came back in Edgar's hand—shock, incredulity, a few lines about a mad act, and a refusal: he was tied up in very important business and could not get mixed up in this thing now.
findings.source_has:
When the butler brought back Wolfshiem’s answer…

 Dear Mr. Carraway. … If there is anything I can do a little later let me know in a letter by Edgar. …

                               Yours truly

and then hasty addenda beneath:

 Let me know about the funeral etc do not know his family at all.
findings.gate_test_answer: A reader is genuinely puzzled who “Edgar” is, since the draft invokes his name without any prior mention or explanation that he is Wolfshiem’s clerk, creating an unexplained proper-noun reference rather than a merely leaner phrasing.
